style_base: Simple crude hand-drawn cartoon in the style of the 'Ecomonos' youtube channel. A recurring brown cartoon monkey character with big round white eyes and black pupils, thick bold black outlines, flat colors, expressive exaggerated faces - but in a DARK HACKER setting: dark near-black navy background, moody lighting, glowing green terminal-code and subtle red accents lighting the scene, the monkey often wearing a dark grey hoodie. Comedy-meets-noir tone. The SAME monkey character appears consistently in every image. CRITICAL TEXT RULE: prefer NO text, labels or signs at all - tell the scene through the monkey's action and expression and simple symbols. If a short text is truly necessary it MUST be in perfect SPANISH exactly as specified, in large simple block letters - NEVER English.
